about: Every owner-facing line of the new-product pipeline (design 1.4). Placeholders in braces are filled by code. Lines marked existing are not copied here: the runtime keeps using the existing text.

questions.ask_identity: I can't tell what this is. What is it, or can you send a clearer photo?
questions.ask_unit: Is that price each or per lb?
questions.ask_price_unit: What's the selling price, and is that each or per lb?
questions.ask_near_maker: Is that the {maker} already on the website?
questions.ask_edit_unclear: I didn't catch that change. What should it say?

prompts.ready: Post this? Reply yes {code}-{n}, or tell me what to change.
prompts.ready_note: A card PNG is attached to every ready prompt. {n} is the version number, so an edit gives a new tag such as 4ed1-2.

compose.rule: Join the parts that apply in priority order (the reverse of drop_order) into one bracket appended to the line; when the bracket would pass bracket_max_chars drop parts from the front of drop_order until it fits.

parts.maker_left_off: maker left off: say "made by …" to add it
parts.name_from_photo: name from the photo: say "it is …" to use yours

guards.not_ready: The card isn't ready to approve yet; use the code on it when it arrives.
guards.which_card: Which card did you mean—please use the code on the latest card.
guards.render_failed: I couldn't draw the card yet; I'll try again when you reply.
guards.live_check_failed: Saved, but the website hasn't shown it yet; I'll check again.
guards.guard_note: Every guard is one line. A guard never offers or attaches a new approval prompt.

confirm.posted: Posted: {url} (say undo to take it down)

edits.picture_request: Send me another photo and I'll use that one.

existing.retake: hass.ops.photos.RETAKE (one sentence per defect code), used as is for a variant of none

never_say: an explanation of the approval rules
